name: Camping Sunnawirt
beschreibung: Camping Sunnawirt is located in the municipality of Heiterwang in the Außerfern region. The campsite is embraced by idyllic meadows and forests, offering quiet pitches for holidaymakers seeking peace and relaxation. The sanitary facilities are impeccably clean and well maintained. Nearby Lake Plansee is a haven for swimming and sailing. Hiking and mountain biking in the surrounding peaks are popular highlights, while in winter the Zugspitze and Berwang ski resorts are reached quickly.
